results.content: In September's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, Fed policymakers once again released their Summary of Economic Projections (SEP). The median projection for headline PCE inflation in 2026 rose to 3.7 percent year over year compared to 3.6 percent in the June SEP. The median projection for core PCE inflation rose to 3.4 percent versus 3.3 percent in June. Policymakers' median projections of the appropriate federal funds rate by the end of 2026 rose to 4.1 percent from 3.8 percent in [...] Figure 3 shows the median FOMC projection for the fed funds rate compared to the actual rate over time.
